title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters Execution Accuracy & campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of structured format that enables efficient resolution Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.) Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) Tik Tok Ads Linked In Ads Trade Desk Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp () is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. title: Fx trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Technical support engineer (analytics focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical support engineer (analytics focused) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both Saa S and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, Dev Ex, Data, and Infra. About Role and Team: As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. Responsibilities: ● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers ● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features) ● Manage critical issues that impact customer's business ● Work with R& D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product ● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers ● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community ● Work with Linux shell, Rest API, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents Work Hours: US East business hours. Main Skills (What You've Already Accomplished... So Far): ● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications ● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications ● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level ● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, Business Objects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas ● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana ● You are familiar with Linux ● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers Nice to have: ● Experience with virtualization and cloud services (AWS, v Sphere) ● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Java Script) ● Experience with No SQL databases such as Mongo DB or Hadoop ● Experience with Rest API ● Networking knowledges

title: Fund operations analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fund operations analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The RoleWe're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team in São Paulo. This is a critical role in our firm's infrastructure, demanding both technical rigor and strong operational ownership.You will be a key member of our back-office team, working directly with the CFO and senior partners to ensure the efficiency, compliance, and scalability of our fund's operations. You will own the \"engine room\" of an international investment fund — managing offshore structures, investor relations, financial controls, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.This role offers significant exposure to the full lifecycle of a growth-stage VC fund and direct interaction with world-class financial service providers.Key Responsibilities· Financial Management & Treasury — Own day-to-day treasury operations for both local (CNPJs) and offshore entities, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow management, FX operations, and bank reconciliations.· Fund Administration Management — Manage the relationship with external stakeholders of the fund's US entities, including Fund Administrators, legal counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors (Big 4).· Investor Relations (IR) Operations — Execute Capital Calls, Distributions, and NAV calculations. Lead LP onboarding (KYC/AML) and serve as the primary point of contact for investor inquiries and reporting.· Financial Reporting & Close — Lead monthly and quarterly close in coordination with external accountants. Review the fund's financial statements for accuracy and compliance (US GAAP / IFRS).· Legal & Governance — Review fund documents (agreements, side letters, subscription docs) and maintain the Data Room to ensure audit readiness at all times.· Fundraising Operations Support — Support capital raising processes, including Data Room management, LP due diligence coordination, and subscription document processing.· Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and implement scalable processes and tools across the fund's back-office.Requirements· 1–3 years of experience in Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Audit (Big 4 or similar), or Corporate Finance / Treasury at a financial institution, investment fund, or large corporation.· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.· Exceptional organizational skills and precision in financial data management.· Advanced proficiency in Excel.· Ability to interpret financial statements, understand fund accounting principles, and flag risks proactively.· Ownership mentality — ability to manage multiple workflows autonomously and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Full-stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-stack engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a senior backend-oriented engineer to help build backend-heavy internal systems for a healthcare company. The ideal candidate will work closely with product and stakeholders to conduct discovery sessions, understand business needs, ask the right questions, design safe integrations, collaborate closely with product/ops teams, and help create the technical foundation for future growth. Main project context: The company provides health-related services through a network of care professionals and is building internal systems to support and scale its operations. The work is mostly greenfield and focused on building secure internal systems for healthcare operations, including EHR and payment/billing integrations, workflow automation, professional matching, operational dashboards, and replacing spreadsheet-based processes with reliable backend logic. Main requirements: - Strong backend experience with Type Script - Experience with AWS and serverless/Lambda - Ability to design and maintain robust third-party API integrations - Comfortable building simple dashboards with React - Strong product collaboration skills - Ability to work independently in a small/early-stage environment - Great communication in English - Experience translating business rules into reliable backend workflows - Senior-level judgment around architecture, data flows, error handling, and maintainability - Familiarity with using AI tools in the software development pipeline, including planning, implementation support, code review, testing, documentation, and improving development workflows Nice to have: - Experience with Healthie or other EHR systems - US healthcare experience - Billing, invoicing, insurance, or payments experience - Prior tech lead experience - Experience as the first or primary engineer on a product/project

title: Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're building a curated network of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking language professionals from Latin America to participate in AI training and evaluation projects with leading AI platforms, research labs, and data companies. This opportunity is ideal for translators, linguists, language professionals, bilingual communicators, and detail-oriented speakers interested in flexible, remote AI-related work. Candidates may apply with expertise in either Spanish OR Portuguese — proficiency in both languages is NOT required. Prior AI experience is NOT required. Unlike traditional full-time roles, these projects are task-based and platform-dependent. Work availability, compensation, and project duration may vary over time. About the Role Selected candidates may be guided through onboarding processes for AI training platforms working with multilingual datasets, language evaluation workflows, speech and text annotation, localization tasks, and AI-generated content review. Typical tasks may include: • Reviewing, evaluating, and improving AI-generated text or speech outputs in Spanish or Portuguese • Identifying linguistic inconsistencies, grammar issues, localization errors, or cultural nuances • Supporting multilingual evaluation, annotation, transcription, translation, or content quality workflows Projects are generally flexible and remote, allowing contributors to work independently on their own schedules. Who We're Looking For We're primarily looking for: • Spanish or Portuguese speakers • Translators • Linguists • Language teachers • Localization specialists • Editors and proofreaders • Communication or humanities students/professionals Preferred qualifications: • Strong written communication skills • Excellent grammar and attention to detail • Solid English comprehension • Experience in translation, editing, localization, or language-related work • Ability to identify tone, nuance, and linguistic inconsistencies • Familiarity with AI, language tools, or annotation platforms is a plus, but not required Important Transparency About the Process Vintti AI is NOT the company directly hiring for these projects. Our role is to identify and represent high-potential LATAM language talent, help candidates navigate onboarding and platform assessments, and share opportunities that may fit their backgrounds. We do not control platform acceptance decisions, project availability, task allocation, or future earnings. Compensation Compensation varies depending on the platform, the project, task complexity and contributor performance. Current market rates for language-related AI projects may range approximately between: USD 20–95/hour, depending on expertise, language specialization, and assignment type. These projects are generally best suited as flexible remote work, freelance income or an additional professional revenue stream, rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Vintti AI Representation Model This model helps support onboarding guidance, candidate support, project navigation and future access to additional AI-related opportunities. Full details are discussed transparently before any formal commitment. Why This Is Interesting AI companies increasingly need human language expertise — not just general annotators. Spanish and Portuguese speakers are becoming essential for training AI systems capable of multilingual communication, localization and translation, speech recognition, cultural adaptation, content evaluation and natural language understanding. This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

Documentação obrigatóriaO profissional deverá apresentar: Currículo atualizado; Documento de identificação profissional; CRM ativo; Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina; Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM; Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM; Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria; RQE (quando aplicável); Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma. Processo seletivoApós análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição. Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail: Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App: informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional. Diferenciais Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência; Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência; Formação complementar em psicoterapia; Fluência em outros idiomas; Disponibilidade para educação continuada. Modelo de atuação
Atendimento 100% online; Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica; Flexibilidade de agenda; Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas; Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional. A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico: Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica; Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas; Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável; Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento. O que esperamos do profissionalMais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com: Responsabilidade profissional; Pontualidade e organização; Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas; Respeito aos pacientes; Ética e humanização no atendimento; Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI. We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale. Why This Role Might Be for You Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn. You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate. Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build. Key Responsibilities Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities. Today: Execution and Precision Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance. Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable. Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously. Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases. Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer. Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage. What We're Looking For Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required. Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company. Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as Open AI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock. Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact. What We Offer Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture. High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI. Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful. Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil. Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us. Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company's story.

title: Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. Qual a formação? - Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica. - Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados. O que precisa ter para participar? - Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal). - Perfil proativo. - Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação. - Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia). - Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas. Indispensável: - Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura - Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato. Se identificou com esta vaga? title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Personal trainers — capte novos alunos através dos desafios do acadenutri
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Personal trainers — capte novos alunos através dos desafios do acadenutri em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga Se você é personal trainer e quer aumentar sua base de alunos, essa oportunidade é para você. O Acadenutri é uma plataforma que conecta profissionais de educação física a pessoas que estão buscando acompanhamento, treino e melhora da qualidade de vida. title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work. At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. What You'll Do Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close. Maintain accurate financial data using Quick Books or other cloud-based accounting tools. Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency. Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core's quality expectations. What We're Looking For Fluent in English Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time) Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools. Nice to Have Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana Prior experience working with startups or small businesses Why You'll Love Working With Us At Aerial Core, we do things differently: Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success. Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained. The Aerial Core Way Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value. Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights. Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base. Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards. Key Responsibilities Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance. Whom Are We looking For We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value. Key Qualifications Node.js, Type Script & React Expertise: Extensive experience with Node JS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity. Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Executivo(a) sênior de vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) sênior de vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com forte perfil comercial para integrar nossa unidade de Interventional Systems no Brasil. Esta posição estratégica terá base em Salvador (BA), com atuação nas regiões Nordeste e Norte, sendo responsável pelo desenvolvimento e expansão do território. Sobre a Posição O(a) profissional será responsável pela gestão de contas, abertura de novos centros implantadores e crescimento do market share, atuando como principal ponto de relacionamento com médicos, hospitais e líderes de opinião. Responsabilidades Gerenciar e expandir o território designado Desenvolver novas contas e oportunidades de negócio Fortalecer relacionamento com médicos, hospitais e KOLs Promover, vender e oferecer suporte técnico aos produtos Acompanhar procedimentos médicos e demonstrar diferenciais técnicos Apoiar negociações, contratos e processos de licitação Trabalhar em conjunto com especialistas de produto em treinamentos Garantir padronização e presença dos produtos no mercado Representar a empresa em eventos e congressos Qualificações Ensino superior completo (Enfermagem, Engenharia, Ciências da Saúde, Marketing ou áreas correlatas) Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em vendas no mercado médico Conhecimento em hemodinâmica, cath lab e rotinas hospitalares Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial Inglês avançado desejável Habilidades Necessárias Perfil "hunter", proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte atuação em campo Experiência sólida em vendas de dispositivos médicos (preferencialmente em hemodinâmica) Vivência em desenvolvimento de território e abertura de contas Excelente capacidade de relacionamento e influência Autonomia, organização e visão estratégica Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial Disponibilidade para viagens: aproximadamente 50% do tempo Por que se juntar à Terumo? Na Terumo, trabalhamos com propósito: contribuir para a sociedade por meio da saúde. Esta é uma oportunidade de atuar em um desafio estratégico, com autonomia e impacto real na vida de pacientes, ampliando o acesso a soluções inovadoras em regiões com grande potencial de crescimento. Se você busca crescimento, desafio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Consultor de inovação ii
description:

Sobre a vaga: O Consultor II em Gestão da Inovação deve atuar no desenvolvimento e execução de serviços de consultoria voltados à inovação, apoiando empresas e instituições na identificação de demandas, criação de soluções inovadoras, prospecção de clientes e fortalecimento da competitividade organizacional. Requisitos Formação: - Ensino superior completo; - Desejável pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à inovação, tecnologia, gestão ou correlatas. Experiência - Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência profissional, preferencialmente em projetos, consultorias ou ambientes ligados à inovação, tecnologia ou desenvolvimento organizacional. Benefícios: Assistência Médica - Saúde Bradesco Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação - R$ 949,36 Plano de Previdência Privada Convênio com o INSS (complementação de auxílio-doença) Auxílio Creche Vitalmed Seguro de Acidentes Pessoais Vale Transporte (1%) Tratamento odontológico / SESI Convênio com Óticas, Livrarias e Farmácias (NUTRICASH) Empréstimo para compra de uniforme escolar Acesso a Clubes e Colônia de férias a preço subsidiado Desconto de 50% no Teatro SESI (+ acompanhante) Cesta de Natal

title: Analista de controladoria sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de controladoria sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio. Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva. Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira. Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio. Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix. Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI). Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros. Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado. Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais. Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão. Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação. Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados. Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação). Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

description:

About Reboot Monkey Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. About the Role Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave. As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings Requirements 3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts) Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring Fluent written and spoken English Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent acquisition specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist About Us: We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it's grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions The Role: We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you're excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds. What You'll Do: Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client's mission Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes What we are looking for: Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing Who You Are: Someone who is not satisfied with "just good enough" and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way Fluent in English and Portuguese Are You Still Curious? If you've read this far, then chances are you've got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can't wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar. Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial: Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa departnershipestruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
